items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury. McVay previously said he's not making great progress and status is TBD for Week 3.
items.why: Hip injury, second consecutive DNP; cautious approach, not long-term but limited progress.
items.implication: Likely limited or out Week 3; elevates Adams target share.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams 142 routes/42% target rate without Nacua historically with strong production.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 3; boosts TE/WR targets in HOU.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz saw 30% route targets and 28% target share without Collins last week; strong TE matchup vs IND.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected season-ending knee surgery (MCL/PCL/meniscus damage, ACL intact). Full recovery expected but 2026 season over.
items.implication: Season over; Giants need QB options (Winston etc).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers missed practice for the second straight day with hamstring; looking like he will miss a second consecutive game. Ravens travel to Brazil.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated after Aug 20 origin; no full practice since Week 1 big half.
items.implication: Expected out again Week 3; opens targets for Bateman/others.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for secondary WRs in BAL offense.

items.text: Comprehensive hurt list: WRs/TEs/QBs include Nacua, Collins, Bowers, AJ Brown, Flowers, Daniels, Williams, Dart, Reed, Murray, Pierce, Pittman, Goedert etc. RBs: Brooks, Dowdle, Mason (meh committees).
items.why: Multiple key absences impacting depth charts and roles.
items.implication: Widespread opportunity shifts; monitor practice reports.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI results; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI, suited up and expects to play.
items.implication: Likely full go Week 3; no major role loss.

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% of routes and team-high 28% target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.why: Elevated usage without Collins + favorable TE matchup.
items.implication: Strong TE1 upside if Collins remains out.
items.opportunity: High route/target share in pass-heavy script potential.

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games with Michael Penix: over 20 PPR ppg, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game.
items.why: Proven high-volume production with healthy Penix (TNF performance noted).
items.implication: Elite WR1 upside with Penix under center.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Production in Nacua-missed games: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.why: Historical route/target data without Nacua; McVay notes limited progress for Nacua.
items.implication: Adams becomes clear WR1 with massive opportunity if Nacua out/limited.

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring in Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated after 5-150-1 first half Week 1, no full practice since. Ravens to Brazil.
items.why: Longer timeline on hamstring with travel complicating recovery.
items.implication: Miss Week 3 highly likely; monitor for return.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for other BAL pass-catchers.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks placed on IR after core muscle surgery; expected to miss at least 6 weeks.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; Chuba Hubbard leads backfield.
items.opportunity: Hubbard clear lead back with thinner committee.

items.text: Bears QB Tyson Bagent officially DNP first practice of week; all signs point to Case Keenum starting.
items.implication: Williams status tied; backup QB implications for CHI offense.
items.opportunity: Potential limited offense or Keenum streaming if Williams out.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson first-quarter fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield with 65% snaps and out-touched him 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead Week 3.
items.why: Post-fumble snap/touch dominance; pass-pro trust still lagging for full takeover.
items.implication: Henderson rising but committee; monitor for more work.
items.opportunity: Increased early-down/overall snaps if fumbles continue.

items.text: MarShawn Lloyd averaging 38% snaps and 10.5 touches/game through 2 weeks; same RZ touches as Brooks, fewer rushes than Kaleb Johnson in W2. Levitan questions if he ceded backfield.
items.why: Limited but steady committee role; TNF questions on ceding.
items.implication: Committee back with some RZ; not full lead.
items.opportunity: Potential more if others limited, but currently shared.
items.conflict: Levitan notes possible cede to Johnson.
